purpose: Determine if the Repair19 shift-only FAIL is the combination of a near-null relative-monitor pathology and finite-time-step truncation on active rows, using a frozen Nt=32/64/128 ladder with no physics, source-sign, boundary or Stage-B threshold change.

ladder.integrator: same frozen Repair07 two-stage Radau IIA canonical march

common_parent_interpolation.reason: isolate H3 time-step behavior without rerunning H1
common_parent_interpolation.source_parent: frozen Repair13 Nt64 Z10 and Z10dot arrays
common_parent_interpolation.target_grids: build_ge15_reference on the same z=1.5 to z=0.2 interval for Nt=32,64,128
common_parent_interpolation.interpolation: PCHIP separately on real and imaginary parts of each frozen Repair13 Nt64 Z10 and Z10dot component
common_parent_interpolation.source_construction: same frozen Repair14 GE06+GE07+Lambda_c2+Y2 construction evaluated on the interpolated frozen Z10 parent
common_parent_interpolation.boundary: same frozen Repair18 q0=0 projected-p0 rule independently reconstructed on each ladder grid

shift_telemetry.near_null_rule: on Nt128 define S_ref=max natural shift scale over all C,beta,m,time samples; classify a sample as near-null if scale <= sqrt(machine_epsilon_float64)*S_ref

required_reports: original all-row shift max at Nt32, Nt64, Nt128 without changing its definition
near-null sample count and active sample count
near-null max absolute residual and ratio to S_ref
active-row shift max at each Nt
active-row absolute residual max and natural scale range
observed convergence orders from actual grid spacings
worst-case locations for all-row and active-row metrics
boundary reproduction, linear-system and anisotropy controls

routing.NEAR_NULL_MONITOR_PLUS_TIME_TRUNCATION_C: near-null absolute residual criterion passes, active Nt128 shift <=1e-6, observed active 64-to-128 order >=2.5, state/linear/anisotropy/boundary controls pass
routing.ACTIVE_SHIFT_PROPAGATION_ISSUE_REMAINS: active Nt128 shift remains above 1e-6 or convergence-order/control requirements fail
routing.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: frozen parent hashes, interpolation identity, source reconstruction, boundary reconstruction or execution fails

interpretation_boundary: Repair20 is diagnostic only. Even a positive route does not retroactively pass Repair19 or certify Z20. A later separately preregistered monitor/certification repair would be required.
